attributes.title: [OpenRouter] Performance
attributes.description: Hourly latency percentiles, throughput, cache hit rate, and guardrail activity broken down by model and provider. Data sourced from metrics-openrouter.performance-*. Note: All metrics are rates/percentiles — use AVG or MAX, never SUM.

params.markdown:
## OpenRouter — Performance Dashboard
Hourly latency percentiles, throughput, and cache efficiency by model and provider.
**Note:** All metrics are non-additive (percentiles/rates). Use `AVG` or `MAX` — never `SUM`.

query.esql:
FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p50_latency IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Avg P50 Latency (ms)` = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_latency), 0)

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p50_latency IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Avg P50 Latency (ms)` = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_latency), 0)

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p99_latency IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Max P99 Latency (ms)` = ROUND(MAX(openrouter.performance.p99_latency), 0)

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p99_latency IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Max P99 Latency (ms)` = ROUND(MAX(openrouter.performance.p99_latency), 0)

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p50_throughput IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Avg P50 Throughput (tok/s)` = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_throughput), 1)

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p50_throughput IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Avg P50 Throughput (tok/s)` = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_throughput), 1)

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS avg_rate = AVG(openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate)
| EVAL `Avg Cache Hit Rate` = ROUND(avg_rate * 100, 1)
| KEEP `Avg Cache Hit Rate`

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS avg_rate = AVG(openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate)
| EVAL `Avg Cache Hit Rate` = ROUND(avg_rate * 100, 1)
| KEEP `Avg Cache Hit Rate`

attributes.title: P50 Latency Over Time by Provider

query.esql:
FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p50_latency IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.performance.provider IS NOT NULL
| STATS p50_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_latency), 0)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), provider = openrouter.performance.provider
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.p50_latency IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.performance.provider IS NOT NULL
| STATS p50_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_latency), 0)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), provider = openrouter.performance.provider
| SORT time_bucket ASC

attributes.title: Cache Hit Rate Over Time by Model

query.esql:
FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.performance.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS cache_rate = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate) * 100, 1)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), model = openrouter.performance.model
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.performance.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS cache_rate = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate) * 100, 1)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), model = openrouter.performance.model
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.guardrail_invoked_rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS guardrail_rate = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.guardrail_invoked_rate) * 100, 2)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.guardrail_invoked_rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS guardrail_rate = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.guardrail_invoked_rate) * 100, 2)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    p50_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_latency), 0),
    p90_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p90_latency), 0),
    p99_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p99_latency), 0),
    p50_ttfb_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_ttfb), 0),
    p50_tput = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_throughput), 1),
    cache_hit_pct = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate) * 100, 1)
  BY model = openrouter.performance.model, provider = openrouter.performance.provider
| SORT p99_ms DESC
| LIMIT 25

FROM metrics-openrouter.performance-*
| WHERE openrouter.performance.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    p50_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_latency), 0),
    p90_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p90_latency), 0),
    p99_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p99_latency), 0),
    p50_ttfb_ms = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_ttfb), 0),
    p50_tput = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.p50_throughput), 1),
    cache_hit_pct = ROUND(AVG(openrouter.performance.cache_hit_rate) * 100, 1)
  BY model = openrouter.performance.model, provider = openrouter.performance.provider
| SORT p99_ms DESC
| LIMIT 25
